## Accounting Tab

The Accounting tab contains non-measurement data that is often used by accounting processes such as the BOL, shipper, and odorant. The fields can vary by ticket type and by transport method. For instance: a Tank Gauge ticket will not include a shipper or transporter, whereas most other ticket types will.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Rail Patterns">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Rail Patterns</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Rail Patterns">

Rail patterns can be used on rail tickets when the shipper for a rail pattern matches the shipper selected for a given ticket. All rail patterns with matching shippers are listed as a choice in the rail pattern drop-down field in the Ticket Editor.

To select a rail pattern, you must first select a shipper that corresponds to a shipper on a rail pattern.

Once you select a rail pattern, the following data points will be copied from the rail pattern onto the ticket:

- All Characteristic and Route fields
- From and To facilities
- Location, product, class, and direction

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="BLM Oil Fields">

In furtherance of Bureau of Land Management regulation 3174.12 (a), the following fields have been added to Meter, Tank Run, and Tank Gauge Tickets.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 439;height: 238;" />

Accounting Tab (Meter Ticket)



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 432;height: 265;" />

Accounting Tab (Tank Run Ticket)

The following options are available on the Accounting tab:

- **Operator** – Name of the operating company. Name must be previously defined in Company Manager.
- **Seal 1 Off/On** – Values that must match the previous and successive tickets associated with a location or tank.
- **Seal 2 Off/On** - Values that must match the previous and successive tickets associated with a location or tank.
- **Witness** – Name of the purchaser’s representative. Must be a previously defined contact under Contact Manager.
- **Gauger** - Only found of Tank Run and Tank Gauge tickets. Name of the person performing the gauging. Must be a previously defined contact under Contact Manager.

</div>
